name: testbench
short: Publish corridor bus events manually, for testing.
description: Owner-only tool that publishes any Corridor agent event through a generated Discord UI, for exercising CCTV projection without a real gateway event.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store any data or metadata about users.
install_msg: Developer tool, hidden from [p]cog list. Install corridor too ([p]cog install pixel-agents-cogs corridor); it loads automatically. Bot owner only: [p]testbench publish sends a hand-built agent event onto corridor's event bus, and cctv shows it to viewers as if it were real. No outside services or stored data.
author: pixel-agents-hq
